name: com.felina.arcoloringbook
description: Toolkit for Unity AR Foundation projects: real-time texture capture, prefab spawning, and material updates. Not an image tracking system. Includes setup wizard and AR Foundation integration. Supports Unity 2019.4+ and AR Foundation 4.x+.

samples.description: Sample scene demonstrating the Scene Setup Wizard (Window > Coloring Book > Scene Setup Wizard). Use this tool to configure your AR Foundation scene. Does not include a pre-configured AR workflow.
